name: 色差分析
description: 检测 color fringing at high-对比度 edges produced by real camera lenses. AI生成的 images typically lack this optical 伪影 since they dont simulate lens physics.
mechanism: 测量 color channel misalignment 跨 the image. Real camera lenses produce predictable radial chromatic aberration. AI images either lack this or produce physically implausible 模式.
parameters: Channel pairs: R-G, R-B, G-B, Measurement: phase 相关性, Radial model: Brown-Conrady
accuracy: 中-高 - 75-85% when chromatic aberration is detectable
source: Johnson and Farid (2006), ACM Workshop on Multimedia and Security
useCase: Detecting absence or 不一致 of lens-induced chromatic aberration

references.title: Johnson, M.K. & Farid, H. (2006). Exposing Digital Forgeries Through Chromatic Aberration. ACM Workshop MMS.
Yerushalmy, I. & Hel-Or, H. (2011). Digital Image Forgery Detection Based on Lens and Sensor Aberration. IJCV.

strengths:
• Based on physical optics of real lenses
• AI generators rarely simulate lens physics
• Predictable radial 模式 in real photos
• Strong 真实性 indicator when present
limitations:
• Not all real photos have detectable aberration
• High-quality lens corrections may remove traces
• Small or cropped images reduce 检测
• Some AI models are learning to add fake aberration
